marta: Vendor pushed a new price sheet for 'Scale Pack' (price_id=SP-2026-09). Need finance + billing ops to confirm grandfathering rules and coupon behavior before any shadow/canary. Sheet: https://vendor.example.com/sheets/SP-2026-09
liam: Quick: reserved commits unchanged or all SKUs?
sophia: Also confirm legacy promo codes remain mapped to old tiers. Can't silently change discounts.
marta: Reserved unaffected. PAYG metered tiers change; grandfathering flags should be respected per mapping.
devin: I sampled the mapping CSV; edge cases: percent coupons, manual-invoice accounts, and monthly-prorate=false. Excerpt: ```acct,grandfathered,apply_new
77111,true,false
77222,false,true```
marta: @billing-bot run preview for cohort "scalepack-exp" (~9k accounts). Return invoice delta histogram and coupon collision rate.
billing-bot: Preview queued job_id=jb_sp_09. ETA ~10m.
billing-bot: Preview complete job_id=jb_sp_09. Summary: cohort_B median invoice +2.0%, coupon collision 0.11%, anomalies: 16 accounts with negative delta > $1k (proration mismatch). Report: https://internal/reports/jb_sp_09
devin: I can hotfix translation table to enforce grandfathering and correct proration. Request approval to patch in canary first.
marta: Approved for canary patch + validate. Abort if coupon collisions >0.5% OR >100 accounts >$1k delta. If canary green, target 1% PAYG canary tomorrow 09:00 PT.
cara: Legal saw an extra termination clause; asked vendor to remove. Not blocking PAYG canary.
